title: Understanding Subscription Plans
description: Learn about Matjrii subscription plans, features, and how to choose the right plan for your business.
content:
Understanding Subscription Plans

Matjrii offers flexible subscription plans designed to meet the needs of businesses of all sizes. This guide will help you understand the available plans and choose the right one for your business.

Available Plans

Matjrii offers several subscription tiers:

  • Free Plan: Perfect for testing and small businesses
  • Basic Plan: Essential features for growing businesses
  • Professional Plan: Advanced features for established businesses
  • Enterprise Plan: Complete feature set for large organizations

Plan Features

Each plan includes different limits and features:

Store Limits

  • Free: Limited number of stores
  • Basic: Multiple stores
  • Professional: Unlimited stores
  • Enterprise: Unlimited stores

Product Limits

  • Free: Limited products per store
  • Basic: Limited products per store
  • Professional: Unlimited products
  • Enterprise: Unlimited products

User Management

  • Free: 1 user per store
  • Basic: Limited users
  • Professional: Multiple users
  • Enterprise: Unlimited users

Storage

  • Free: Basic storage
  • Basic: Limited storage
  • Professional: High storage
  • Enterprise: Unlimited storage

Advanced Features

Higher plans include:

  • Custom domain support
  • PWA (Progressive Web App) features
  • AI content generation
  • Blog system
  • Custom pages
  • POS system
  • Advanced analytics
  • API access
  • White label options

Billing Cycles

Plans are available in two billing cycles:

  • Monthly: Pay monthly for flexibility
  • Yearly: Pay annually for discounts

Choosing the Right Plan

Consider these factors when choosing a plan:

  1. Number of Stores: How many stores do you need?
  2. Products: How many products will you have?
  3. Team Size: How many users need access?
  4. Features: Which advanced features do you need?
  5. Budget: What's your monthly budget?

Upgrading or Downgrading

You can upgrade or downgrade your plan at any time:

  1. Navigate to Plans in your dashboard
  2. Select a new plan
  3. Review the changes
  4. Confirm the change

Changes take effect immediately. You'll be charged or credited the difference on a prorated basis.

Free Trials

Some plans offer free trials. During the trial period:

  • You have access to all plan features
  • No credit card required
  • Automatic conversion after trial ends

Coupon Codes

You can apply coupon codes during checkout to get discounts on subscription plans. Enter the coupon code in the checkout form.

Next Steps

After selecting a plan, you're ready to create your first store.
